title: Verify a standard user can log in
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter password
4. Click the Login button
expected: User is redirected to Inventory page and Products heading is displayed

title: Verify a locked out user cannot log in
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter Username
3. Enter password
4. Click Login
expected: Error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown. User stays on the Login page

title: Verify a wrong password is rejected
steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter wrong password
4. Click Login
expected: Error message: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

title: Verify checkboxes can be ticked and unticked
expected: checkbox 1 is checked; checkbox 2 is unchecked

title: Verify an option can be chosen from the dropdown
steps:
1. Open https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dropdown
2. Select "Option 2" from the dropdown list

title: Verify email rejects an already registered address
steps:
1. Enter Email (Email Address)
2. Continue as applicable
3. Reach the OTP step
expected: Error "This email is already registered" is shown. System rejects the email
